title: Yellowed Flaky Australian Fish Pie
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring charred, flaky fish in a cider vinegar infused beurre-monte sauce, this pie is a delicious and nut-free friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the cider vinegar, beurre-monte, and flour, whisking continuously over medium heat until the mixture thickens.
Add the butter, milk, egg, salt, and pepper to the saucepan, stirring until the butter has melted and the mixture is smooth.
Arrange the cod fillets in a baking dish and pour the beurre-monte sauce over the top.
Sprinkle the frozen mixed vegetables over the sauce.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the top is lightly charred.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the fish pie hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
